note: Rejudged at HEAD after checkPPPCodeReject replaced fail(7, parseErr) with pppCodeRejectFailure(name, 7, parseErr) and session_run.go::writeFrame gained a transmit MRU length guard before writing to s.chanFile. Re-read RFC 1661 Section 6.6: 'By default, all implementations MUST transmit frames with Address and Control fields appropriate to the link framing.' The transmit MRU guard in writeFrame does not alter Address/Control framing, and assertion 7 still verifies strict ff 03 framing across the full live L2TP session capture. However, the proof covers only the kernel L2TP path (not PPPoE's frameless RFC 2516 encapsulation), has only a positive tag without single-polarity, and relay-side breaks do not verify the kernel/PPP writer boundary under the {lower-layer} attribution. Weak stands.
